caption: The drawing depicts a single object, an eagle with its wings spread wide horizontally. The eagle is rendered in shades of brown, gold, and yellow, with darker brown used for shadows and outlining feathers, and reddish hues accentuating the edges and contours of the wings and body. The feathers are intricately detailed, with distinct layers visible on the wings, body, and tail. The eagle's head is turned to its left with a slightly open beak. The bird’s talons grasp a bundle which appears decorated with star shapes and floral elements, and there is a vertical support beneath it. The background is plain and off-white, with no other objects or elements present.
title: Eagle
